title: v1 saturates on IAFDB — labels ~everything fibrotic
description: Running the Phase-1 model on the unlabeled IAFDB bank as a label-free sanity check, P(fibrotic) sits at ~0.999 for essentially every segment regardless of segment — a saturated decision function with no usable operating threshold. This is the 'clearly wrong' directional baseline the Phase-1.5 synthetic-realism work aims to move away from; it is not a scored validation (IAFDB has no fibrosis ground truth).
